description:
`gf2-sim::checkpoint_compat test_kill_mid_write_randomized_defense_in_depth` failed (exit 100) in a cargo-ci gate run at commit f7bd28c7 while only light shell work ran beside it, and passes when run solo (`cargo nextest run -p gf2-sim --all-features --release --profile ci -E 'test(test_kill_mid_write_randomized_defense_in_depth)'`, PASS 0.079s). The immediately following cargo-ci run on the same tree passed, so the failure is load- or seed-dependent rather than a regression of the tree under test.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The failure mode is reproduced or bounded (seed capture, kill-window widening under nice/load, or documented non-reproduction after a stated number of contended runs).
- [hard] REQ-02: The test is made robust to host load without weakening what it verifies (no wall-clock widening per AGENTS.md; restructure the kill window or make the randomness seed-reported and replayable).
title: Flaky test: kill_mid_write_randomized_defense_in_depth fails under host load
